name: Envelope
fullname: Envelope: ADDSR, or one shot (D, H, AHD)
summary: ADDSR, or one shot (D, H, AHD).
author: Animatek
about: The G2's ADDSR, H, D and Mod AHD envelopes from one engine. Stages: attack, decay 1 (to Level 1), decay 2 (to Sustain) and release. Each is an exponential approach, from instant to about 17 seconds. Env goes from 0 to +64 units, and End is high while the envelope is idle.

Gate mode: it holds at Sustain while Gate is high, and releases when Gate falls (the ADDSR). Trig mode: the length of the gate does not matter, and decay 2 goes on into the release when it reaches Sustain (the D, the H with Decay 1 at Level 1 as the hold, the AHD).
usage: Gate mode with Attack and Release: a normal envelope for an amplifier.
Trig mode: a percussive shape that fires on any trigger.
End goes high when the envelope finishes: use it to trigger the next event.
notes: No time-modulation inputs yet (the Mod AHD's). Control rate.
